title: Jio Platforms IPO: Up to ₹30,213 Cr, Zero to Sellers #Shorts
description:
Up to ₹30,213 crore is being raised in the Jio Platforms IPO, and none of it goes to a seller. It is a fresh issue of up to 27 crore new shares, so the money goes to the company, mainly to repay borrowings of Reliance Jio Infocomm. Compare Hyundai India's roughly ₹27,870 crore IPO in 2024, where all the money went to the seller. Bidding is scheduled for 21–23 October and listing for 28 October 2026 on NSE and BSE. IPOs can list below the issue price. Educational only. Not financial advice.
Footage: stock clips for illustration (Pixabay/Wikimedia Commons), not of the actual event.
Subscribe for clear, hopeful explainers.
Source: Jio Platforms IPO RHP / price-band notice; Hyundai Motor India IPO, 2024.
#Shorts #JioIPO #JioPlatformsIPO #IPOExplained #HopeverseMedia
